title: Keep July Coverage Exact
teaser: A monthly shard must never absorb records from an adjacent month.
full_text: Compile the July shard and verify it contains exactly the thirty one dates from July 1 through July 31 2035.

title: Preserve Delta T Provenance in UTC to TT Conversion
teaser: Time-scale conversion must not rely on an unexplained constant.
full_text: Run a known-date fixture through UTC to TT conversion and verify the Delta T source is retained in result metadata.

title: Test Retrograde State at the Station Boundary
teaser: Direction labels must remain stable when apparent speed approaches zero.
full_text: Calculate consecutive ephemeris samples around a station and verify the direct retrograde transition occurs at one defined threshold.

title: Hide Ascendant for Unknown Birth Time
teaser: A missing birth time must not produce a seemingly precise rising sign.
full_text: Open an unknown-time profile and verify the ascendant card shows the contracted uncertainty state instead of a calculated value.

title: Validate Backup Manifest Version Before Restore
teaser: Older clients must not silently open unknown future package formats.
full_text: Create a package with an unsupported manifest version and verify restore stops with an explicit compatibility error before mutation.

title: Detect Missing Files Listed by Backup Hashes
teaser: A manifest entry without its physical payload must invalidate restore.
full_text: Remove one declared data file from a package and verify integrity validation rejects the archive before any write occurs.

title: Separate PDF Section IDs from Localized Titles
teaser: Changing display language must not change report section identity.
full_text: Generate the same report in Turkish and English and verify navigation targets retain identical stable section IDs.

title: Preserve the Exact Date Key Across Locale Changes
teaser: Switching interface language must not reinterpret the selected daily-message date.
full_text: Move between Turkish and English views for one civil date and verify the exact date key remains unchanged.

title: Measure Rewarded Unlock Duration with a Monotonic Clock
teaser: Rolling system time backward must not extend temporary access.
full_text: Start a temporary unlock then move wall time backward and verify entitlement still expires from the rollback-resistant time source.

title: Fail Closed on Corrupted PRO Cache
teaser: Unreadable entitlement data must never grant paid access.
full_text: Launch with a malformed cache payload and verify protected features remain locked without verified ownership.

title: Apply Linked-Record Policy When Deleting Profiles
teaser: Profile removal must not leave orphaned charts or consultation records.
full_text: Delete a profile with linked charts and notes and verify the contracted cascade or blocking policy executes within one transaction.

title: Match Semantics Traversal to Visual Reading Order
teaser: Screen-reader focus should not jump through cards in an illogical sequence.
full_text: Inspect traversal order on the Today screen and verify it follows the same meaningful order as the visible layout.

title: Enforce Minimum Touch Targets for Icons
teaser: Small visual icons must still provide accessible hit areas.
full_text: Measure navigation and toolbar controls and verify every interactive target meets the platform minimum dimensions.

title: Show Country Context for Duplicate City Names
teaser: Disambiguation must give users enough information to choose the correct location.
full_text: Render same-name city fixtures and verify country plus regional context is visible before selection.

title: Reject Local Times Inside a DST Gap
teaser: A nonexistent civil time must not be normalized silently to a later clock value.
full_text: Submit a birth time inside a spring-forward gap and verify the timezone layer returns an explicit nonexistent-time state.

title: Do Not Invent Ephemeris Fallback Outside Supported Range
teaser: Unsupported dates must not produce approximate planetary positions without proof.
full_text: Query beyond bundled ephemeris coverage and verify the provider fails closed with an explicit range error.

title: Lock Aspect Orb Inclusion at the Boundary
teaser: Angles exactly on an orb limit must behave consistently across builds.
full_text: Run fixtures just below exactly at and just above the configured orb threshold and compare results with the golden inclusive policy.

title: Preserve Unicode During Numerology Name Normalization
teaser: Non-ASCII letters must not be stripped by an accidental normalization shortcut.
full_text: Evaluate names containing Turkish dotted and dotless I and verify characters are transformed only by the documented transliteration policy.

title: Fix the BaZi Day-Pillar Midnight Policy
teaser: Day rollover must not differ between screens or calculation entry points.
full_text: Calculate local civil times around late evening and midnight and verify every path uses the same canonical day-pillar boundary policy.

title: Match Asset Manifest Hashes to File Bytes
teaser: A modified file with the same name must not remain trusted.
full_text: Change one manifested asset and verify checksum validation blocks the release package.

title: Use the Bundled City Index for Offline Search
teaser: Core location selection should remain available without network access.
full_text: Search for cities in airplane mode and verify bundled results return stable location IDs with usable disambiguation metadata.

title: Do Not Advance Schema Version After Failed Migration
teaser: A partial migration must never be recorded as successful.
full_text: Inject an error midway through migration and verify both data state and schema version roll back to the previous revision.

title: Make Search Index Rebuilds Deterministic
teaser: Identical source data must not produce unstable result ordering.
full_text: Rebuild the index twice from the same dataset and verify normalized tokens plus stable-ID ordering are byte-for-byte equivalent.

title: Limit Personal Data in Export Filenames
teaser: Shared filenames should not reveal unnecessary birth or profile details.
full_text: Generate profile and report exports and verify filenames contain no sensitive fields outside the approved naming policy.

title: Verify Rendered PDF Page Count with a Parser
teaser: Reported pagination must agree with the actual document structure.
full_text: Build a multi-section report then open it with the parser and compare its page-tree count with generated metadata.

title: Canonicalize CSV Line Endings Across Platforms
teaser: Operating-system defaults must not change export bytes unexpectedly.
full_text: Export the same fixture under different line-ending environments and verify the canonical CSV byte sequence remains identical.

title: Resolve Notification Deep Links by Stable Route ID
teaser: Notification taps must not depend on localized display labels.
full_text: Open equivalent Turkish and English notifications and verify both resolve the destination through the same stable route identifier.

title: Revalidate Entitlement from Persistence After Cold Start
teaser: Process death must not preserve stale in-memory access state.
full_text: Fully terminate and relaunch the app and verify access is reconstructed from the signed persisted entitlement source.

title: Scan July Against Historical Exact Collisions
teaser: Fresh editorial copy must not repeat earlier monthly text verbatim.
full_text: Compare July English title teaser and full-text fields against prior English shards and reject any exact collision.

title: Audit English as an Independent Editorial Track
teaser: English records must stand on their own rather than depend on mechanical translation.
full_text: Review the July English shard against its own quality rules and verify every record is complete without cross-locale fallback.

title: Close July Coverage from Main
teaser: Only committed contiguous shards may count as reviewed coverage.
full_text: Reload both July shards from main verify thirty one canonical dates per locale and record August 1 2035 as the next exact start.
